messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Portuguese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Portuguese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word/Phrase (Portuguese) | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|--------------------------------|------------------------|--------| | Tant' | adverb “to such a degree” (intensifier) | **Tão** | “so / such” | OK | | è | copular verb “is” | **é** | “is” | OK | | amara | adjective “bitter” | **amarga** | “bitter” | **GRAMMAR** (gender mismatch – should be *amargo* for a neuter/masc. referent) | | che | conjunction “that” (resultative) | **que** | “that” | OK | | poco | adverb “little” (slight degree) | **pouco** | “little” | OK | | è | copular verb “is” (comparative clause) | **é** | “is” | OK | | più | comparative adverb “more” | **mais** | “more” | OK | | morte | noun “death” | **morte** | “death” | OK | | ma | coordinating conjunction “but” | **Mas** | “but” | OK | | per | preposition “in order to” (purpose) | **para** | “to / in order to” | OK | | trattar | infinitive verb “to treat / discuss” | **tratar** | “to treat / discuss” | OK | | del | contraction *di + il* “of the” | **do** | “of the” | OK | | ben | noun “good” | **bem** | “good” | OK | | ch' | relative pronoun “that” | **que** | “that” | OK | | i' | pronoun “I” | **eu** | “I” | OK | | vi | adverb “there” (locative) | **lá** | “there” | OK | | trovai | verb “found” (preterite) | **encontrei** | “found” | OK | | dirò | future verb “I will tell” | **Direi** | “I will tell” | OK | | de | preposition “of” | **das** | “of the” (plural fem.) | OK | | l'altre | adjective “other” (fem. pl.) | **outras** | “other” | OK | | cose | noun “things” (fem. pl.) | **coisas** | “things” | OK | | ch' | relative pronoun “that” | **que** | “that” | OK | | i' | pronoun “I” | **eu** | “I” | OK | | v' | clitic pronoun “vi” (locative “there”) | **lá** | “there” | OK | | ho | auxiliary verb “have” (perfect) | — | — | **MISSING** | | scorte | past participle “seen” | — | — | **MISSING** |

### Items Requiring Attention - **GRAMMAR:** *amarga* – gender agreement error; the adjective should be masculine (*amargo*) or the sentence re‑phrased to match a feminine noun. - **MISSING:** *ho* (auxiliary “have”) – not rendered in the Portuguese version. - **MISSING:** *scorte* (past participle “seen”) – the perfect aspect is collapsed into the simple past *vi*; the auxiliary and participle are therefore omitted.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Portuguese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Portuguese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 7: - Original: **Tão amarga é isso que a morte é pouco mais;** - Issue: **GRAMMAR** – adjective gender mismatch (*amarga* vs. neuter “isso”). - Corrected: **Tão amargo é isso que a morte é pouco mais;**
- Line 8: - Original: **Mas para tratar do bem que eu encontrei lá,** - Issue: none - Corrected: **no change**
- Line 9: - Original: **Direi das outras coisas que eu vi lá.** - Issue: **MISSING** – auxiliary “ho” and participle “scorte” not rendered. - Corrected: **Direi das outras coisas que eu tenho visto lá.**
